authority: Mumbai Port Authority (MbPA) / Survey of India Geodetic Branch

vertical_datums.chart_datum_definition: Zero of the tide gauge at Apollo Bunder, corresponding approximately to the lowest astronomical low water.

critical_thresholds_for_urban_drainage.explanation: When water level exceeds 4.50m CD (approx. +1.99m MSL), 135 out of Mumbai's 186 outfalls are completely submerged. Gravity drainage drops to zero. Any precipitation exceeding 25 mm/hr directly causes compound pluvial-coastal flash flooding.
